text_block_list.text:
Though Грасс Вандер runs a
picture-perfect
race, it doesn't clear her
reputation as
Марузенски's successor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She sets her sights on a direct clash with

Марузенски to break free of the
association once
and for all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she needs to build up experience in
the
Classics first to make it a reality. The
Japanese
Derby becomes our next goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
